method: Read every local paragraph manually, compare all five complete Wikisource chapters, retain exact local evidence and explicit corrected excerpts. This is a conservative inventory, not regex extraction and not a list of completed designs.

selectionPolicy.include: Distinctive beasts, named divine/mythic identities, unusual peoples, distinctive plants. Retain named genealogy and ambiguous taxa as conditional candidates rather than silently dropping them.
selectionPolicy.exclude: Individual mountains/rivers/minerals, instruments, generic ordinary animals/plants, country/place names without an individual or unusual people description.
selectionPolicy.counting: Identity/group keys are not a final character count. Groups and named members, variant readings and across-chapter occurrences require deduplication. Conditional entries are not generation-ready.
selectionPolicy.designBoundary: Original appearance, youthful handsome/beautiful adaptation, and newly invented yokai body details must remain separate fields in later character briefs. No current population is asserted to have mythical anatomy.
